name: TOASST (Tiny Open Android Smartphone-based Smart Telescope)

mentions.name: TOASST (Tiny Open Android Smartphone-based Smart Telescope)
mentions.description: DIY smart telescope (TOASST) that repurposes a smartphone's camera for electronically assisted astronomy and astrophotography, similar to a Seestar. The project includes a SolidWorks-designed 3D-printable mount that holds the phone, Arduino firmware to drive the mount, and a planned small Android app that controls the mount and coordinates astrophotography sessions, served over a Wi-Fi hotspot so results can be viewed on another device. The whole design is intended to be easy and cheap to print and build.
mentions.problem: Commercial smart telescopes like the Seestar are expensive; this project offers a cheap, easy-to-build DIY alternative using an old smartphone.
mentions.audience: Aimed at hobbyists; designed so a motivated teenager with minimal experience and an old smartphone can build it.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a thing I'm calling TOASST, or the Tiny Open Android Smartphone-based Smart Telescope. The basic idea is to use a smartphone (often the best camera in your house) to do electronically assisted astronomy/astrophotography a la Seestar.
